an5.38:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these five benefits come to a clansman endowed with faith.
an5.38:1.3: (1) When the good persons in the world show compassion, they first show compassion to the person with faith, not so to the person without faith.
an5.38:1.4: (2) When they approach anyone, they first approach the person with faith, not so the person without faith.
an5.38:1.5: (3) When they receive alms, they first receive alms from the person with faith, not so from the person without faith.
an5.38:1.6: (4) When they teach the Dhamma, they first teach the Dhamma to the person with faith, not so to the person without faith.
an5.38:1.7: (5) With the breakup of the body, after death, a person with faith is reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world.
an5.38:1.8: These are the five benefits that come to a clansman who has faith.
an5.38:2.1: “Just as at a crossroads on level ground, a great banyan tree becomes the resort for birds all around,
an5.38:2.2: so the clansman endowed with faith becomes the resort for many people: for bhikkhus, bhikkhunīs, male lay followers, and female lay followers.”
an5.38:3.1: A large tree with a mighty trunk,
an5.38:3.4: is a support for many birds.
an5.38:4.2: the birds resort to this delightful base:
an5.38:4.3: those in need of shade partake of its shade;
an5.38:4.4: those needing fruit enjoy its fruit.
an5.38:5.1: Just so, when a person is virtuous,
an5.38:6.1: those in the world who are fields of merit—
an5.38:7.4: the taintless one here attains nibbāna.
